
---

One binary per system, unpack and run `guppy-app`.

- **Linux:** needs a Vulkan or OpenGL driver (Mesa is enough).
- **macOS (Apple Silicon):** the binary isn't signed. After unpacking run
  `xattr -d com.apple.quarantine guppy-app` once, or right-click → Open.
- **Windows:** SmartScreen may warn because the exe isn't signed; "More info" → "Run anyway".

Optional helper programs (PDF/video preview, 7z …) can be installed from
Settings (F12) → Helper programs.
